Differential abundance
Load the tables
```{r,  results="hide"}
set.seed(01122025)
ASVtaxonomy=read.csv(file.path("../InputData", "16S_ASV_Table_LTE_three_years.csv"))
ASVtaxonomy=select(ASVtaxonomy, ASV, everything())
#Keep the taxonomy of the ASV table
ASVtaxonomy=ASVtaxonomy[,c(1:10)]

for(i in 1:nrow( ASVtaxonomy)){
  for(j in 1:ncol( ASVtaxonomy)){
    if( is.na( ASVtaxonomy[i,j])==T){
      ASVtaxonomy[i,j]=ASVtaxonomy[i,(j-1)]
  }
}  
}

ASVtable1= read.csv(file.path("../InputData", "16SMLERarefied_table.csv"), row.names = "X")
Mean_abundances=as.data.frame(
  apply(ASVtable1, 2, function(x) mean(x)))
Frequencies=as.data.frame(
  apply(ASVtable1, 2, function(x) sum(x>0))
)
metadata=read.csv(file.path("../InputData", "metadata1.csv"))%>%na.omit()
metadata$ID=metadata$Sample
metadata$Soil_Type[metadata$Soil_Type=="RAS"]="BS"
```


Generate metadata from the sample names
Convert Tillage and Fertilization intensity (Int) to numerical values (0,1)

```{r,  results="hide"}
metadata$Tillage2=metadata$Tillage
metadata$Tillage2[metadata$Tillage2=="CT"]=0
metadata$Tillage2[metadata$Tillage2=="MP"]=1
metadata$Tillage2=as.numeric(metadata$Tillage2)
metadata$Group=paste0(metadata$Soil_Type, "|", metadata$Year)
```
Set the multiple logistic regression
```{r,  results="hide"}

multiple_glm= function(x){
   


  Table_glm=glm(file1$Tillage2~compositions::clr(x+1), family=binomial(link="logit"))
  file2=anova(Table_glm, test = "Chisq")
  FC1=dcast(data.frame(T=file1$Tillage, A=x), T~., value.var = "A",  mean)
  FC2=log2((FC1[2,2]+1)/(FC1[1,2]+1))
  file3=data.frame(coeff=(Table_glm$coefficients[2]), p=file2$`Pr(>Chi)`[2], FC=FC2, Mean=mean(x))
  
  return(file3)
}
```

```{r}
comparison_list=list()
for (i in unique(metadata$Group)){
  print(i)
  file1=filter(metadata, Group==paste0(i) )
  input1=(as.data.frame(ASVtable1[file1$ID,]))
  input2=as.data.frame( apply(input1, 2, function (x) sum(x>0)))
  colnames(input2)<-"Count"
  input2=filter(input2, Count>3)
  input3=as.data.frame(( input1[file1$ID,rownames(input2)]))
  multiple_glms_2020_ASVs= apply(input3,2, function(x) multiple_glm(x))
  multiple_glms_ASVs_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, multiple_glms_2020_ASVs))
  multiple_glms_ASVs_df[is.na(multiple_glms_ASVs_df)]<-1
  multiple_glms_ASVs_df$padj=p.adjust(multiple_glms_ASVs_df$p, method="BH")
  multiple_glms_ASVs_df=filter(multiple_glms_ASVs_df)%>%mutate(
   Year=unique(file1$Year ),Soil_Type= unique( file1$Soil_Type))
  comparison_list=rbind(multiple_glms_ASVs_df%>%rownames_to_column(var="ASV"),comparison_list)
  
}
```

```{r}
comparison_list2=filter(full_join( comparison_list, ASVtaxonomy ), padj<0.05)
set3_colors <- brewer.pal(12,"Set3")
additional_colors <- c("white","black","grey")
my_palette <- c(set3_colors, additional_colors)

comparison_list2$Year <- factor(comparison_list2$Year, levels = sort(unique(comparison_list2$Year)))

plotPhylum= ggplot(comparison_list2, aes(x=log10(100*(Mean)/15349), y=FC, fill=tax.Phylum)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=5) +
  facet_grid(Year ~ Soil_Type, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_palette, name="ASV taxonomy (phylum level)") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour="black")) +
  theme(strip.text=element_text(colour="black", size=25)) +
  
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=25,colour="black")) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=25,colour="black")) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=25,colour="black")) +

  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=25,colour="black")) + 
  theme(legend.title=element_text(size=25,colour="black")) + 
  theme(legend.position="right", axis.title.y=element_text(size=25,colour="black")) + 
  theme(legend.key.size=unit(2,"cm")) +

  ylab(expression("Log2 FC")) +
  xlab(expression("Mean Log10 RA")) 

png(filename = "Fig2_RespondersPhylum_revised.png", height = 6000,
    width = 5500, res=350)
print(plotPhylum) 
dev.off()


```

Plot the results of the venn diagramms

```{r,  results="hide"}
# Year 2019
BS_pos_resp_2019 <- comparison_list2 %>% filter(Soil_Type == "BS", coeff > 0, Year==2019)
BS_neg_resp_2019 <- comparison_list2 %>% filter(Soil_Type == "BS", coeff < 0, Year==2019)
RH_pos_resp_2019 <- comparison_list2 %>% filter(Soil_Type == "RH", coeff > 0, Year==2019)
RH_neg_resp_2019 <- comparison_list2 %>% filter(Soil_Type == "RH", coeff < 0, Year==2019)

data_pos_2019 <- list(
     "BS" = BS_pos_resp_2019$ASV
    ,"RH" = RH_pos_resp_2019$ASV
)

data_neg_2019 <- list(
     "BS" = BS_neg_resp_2019$ASV
    ,"RH" = RH_neg_resp_2019$ASV
)

plot_pos_2019 <- ggvenn(data_pos_2019, 
  c("BS", "RH"),set_name_size=4,text_size=4) + 
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))

plot_neg_2019 <- ggvenn(data_neg_2019, 
  c("BS", "RH"),set_name_size=4,text_size=4) +
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))

plot_2019 <- ggarrange(plot_pos_2019, plot_neg_2019, ncol=2, labels=c("MP-responders (positive)", "CT-responders (negative)"), font.label=list(size=14, face="bold"))

# Year 2020
```
